title: etbb-july-2024-february-2026-update.pdf — section 404
text:
61. The Magistrates’ Association recommends:
• Recognising that lack of trust may affect engagement with the court process, including
the behaviour of the defendant in court, and use of “no comment”.
• Building trust by explaining court processes, and treating the defendant with respect.
• Where individuals are labelled as “gang members” in pre-sentence reports, asking for
supporting evidence.
Care and family courts

62. Judges dealing with family cases will need to delicately balance respect for different
approaches to parenting within a diverse range of cultural norms and, at the same time, aim
to protect all children from potential parental maltreatment.
